extDescription.message: Organize your x.com bookmarks into your own folders. All data stays on your device.

noFolders.message: Folders you create will be listed here

confirmDelete.message: Delete this folder? The saved posts will not be deleted.

collectTitle.message: Import posts on this page into PostShelf

syncNativeDesc1.message: When you save a post to a folder, PostShelf also adds it to your standard X bookmarks.

syncNativeDesc2.message: When you remove it from all folders, the X bookmark is removed too.

syncNativeDesc3.message: PostShelf presses the on-screen bookmark button only once per post you act on.

dataMoveDesc.message: Export your saved posts and folders to a file, or import them from one.

buttonModeHeading.message: Behavior of the standard bookmark button

buttonModeSeparate.message: Add a separate PostShelf button (leave the standard button alone)

buttonModeReplace.message: Replace the standard button (Shift+click for X default)

buttonModeNote.message: This may stop working after X updates. If it does, the standard behavior is used instead.

confirmDeletePosts.message: Delete $COUNT$ post(s) from PostShelf? Your X bookmarks are not changed.

actionModeNote.message: The side panel requires Chrome 114 or later.

importBanner.message: $COUNT$ posts on your x.com Bookmarks can be imported

importHowSteps.message:
1. In Chrome, open "History" in the x.com left menu and choose the "Bookmarks" tab (x.com/i/history)
2. Scroll yourself until the posts you want are on screen (PostShelf never auto-scrolls)
3. Press the "N not yet imported" button at the bottom right
4. Imported posts go to "Unsorted"

viewFullOnX.message: See the full text on X

notFoundHint.message: Try a different search or clear the filters.

noPostsHint.message: Press the folder button on a post on x.com to save it. Posts you have already bookmarked can be imported from Bookmarks in your x.com history.

saveCurrentHint.message: Shown while a post is open on x.com

saveCurrentFail.message: Could not read this post. Reload the page and try again.

healthUnknown.message: Not checked yet (it is checked when you open x.com)

healthDegraded.message: Parts of the X page structure have changed. PostShelf is still working.

healthBroken.message: The X page structure has changed, so some features are paused. Please copy the diagnostic info and report it on GitHub.

diagNotice.message: This content will be copied to the clipboard. It does not include post text, usernames, or URLs. It does include the extension version, browser information, display language, and the outline of X's page structure.

diagCopyFail.message: Could not copy. Please select the text and copy it manually.

accountUnknown.message: Can't tell which account is logged in, so nothing can be saved. Please reload the x.com page.

collectNoAccount.message: Can't tell which account is logged in, so nothing can be imported

accountSwitchNote.message: Switching here does not change who is logged in on X. Switch your X account on x.com.

accountAssignDesc.message: Moves the saved data of $NAME$ ($COUNT$ posts) to the account you choose. If the same post already exists there, the folders that post is in are combined.

accountAssignNone.message: There is no account to move to. Open x.com while logged in, and the account becomes available to choose here.

accountDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the saved data of $NAME$ ($COUNT$ posts and its folders)? This cannot be undone. Your X bookmarks are not changed.

accountUnknownBanner.message: $COUNT$ posts are saved under "No account set". Choose which account they belong to and use "Reassign…".

saveCurrentNoAccount.message: Can't tell which account is logged in on x.com, so nothing can be saved. Reload the x.com page.

saveCurrentWrongAccount.message: The account shown in PostShelf differs from $NAME$, who is logged in on x.com, so nothing can be saved. Switch the account shown here to $NAME$.

settingsResetDesc.message: Only settings are reset: sync mode, native button behavior, how PostShelf opens, view and sort, and so on. Folders, saved posts and account info are kept.

settingsResetConfirm.message: Reset settings to their defaults? Your saved posts and folders will not be deleted.

deleteAllDesc.message: Deletes all folders, saved posts and account info. Settings are kept. This cannot be undone.

deleteAllCounts.message: Will be deleted: $FOLDERS$ folders, $POSTS$ posts, $ACCOUNTS$ accounts

deleteAllWarn.message: This cannot be undone. Your X bookmarks are not changed. To continue, type "$WORD$" below.

viewerFailTitle.message: The image could not be loaded

viewerFailReason.message: The original post may have been deleted, or X may have moved the image.

videoOpenLabel.message: Show how to play this video

videoDialogBody.message: PostShelf cannot play videos because the video file itself cannot be saved.

cacheEnableDesc.message: When you save a post, its images are also kept on this computer, so you can still see them if they disappear from X. For videos, only the thumbnail is kept.

cacheCollapsedHint.message: Turn on to choose where to save, the size limit and the quality

cachePermNote.message: The first time you turn this on, Chrome asks for permission to access pbs.twimg.com (X's image server). Permission is requested only when you turn this feature on.

cachePermDenied.message: Image caching could not be turned on because access to the image server was not allowed. Turn it on again and allow access.

cachePermMissing.message: Access to the image server (pbs.twimg.com) is not allowed.

cacheDestIdb.message: Inside the browser (the extension's data area; recommended)

cacheDestDir.message: A folder I choose (anywhere on this PC)

cacheDirPermNote.message: After Chrome restarts, access to the folder may be revoked. Until you allow it again, images are not written to the folder and are loaded from X's image server instead.

cacheDirTabOnly.message: The folder is chosen on the tab version of the manager page (it cannot be chosen in the side panel). Please choose it there.

cacheDirUnsupported.message: A folder could not be chosen on this extension page. Please use "Inside the browser" instead.

cacheDirReadme.message:
This is the PostShelf image cache. Deleting it does not delete PostShelf's own data.
The "images" folder contains one folder per post ID.

cacheDirNonEmpty.message: This folder was not created by PostShelf and already contains other files. May PostShelf create ".postshelf", "README.txt" and an "images" folder here? Other files in the folder are left untouched.

cacheMaxMin.message: The maximum size must be at least 100 MB.

cacheQualityLarge.message: Standard (estimated 0.2–0.5 MB each; enough for viewing)

cacheQualityOrig.message: Original size (estimated 1–5 MB each; uses up space faster)

cacheFull.message: When the size limit is reached

cacheFullEvict.message: Delete the oldest first (images of the earliest saved posts)

cacheBulk.message: Cache images of all saved posts

cacheBulkNothing.message: There are no images to cache

cacheBulkBlocked.message: Stopped because the destination could not be written to. Please check the permission and the folder.

cacheBulkFull.message: Stopped because the size limit was reached.

cacheBulkHelp.message: Caching all posts loads images one by one. Progress is shown, and you can stop at any time. If you stop, the next run continues where it left off. Deleting a post also deletes its images.

cacheClearConfirm.message: Delete the cached images ($COUNT$ images)? Your saved posts are kept. Images will be loaded from X's image server instead.

cacheLowerConfirm.message: Lowering the maximum size will immediately delete the images of the $COUNT$ oldest saved posts. Continue?

cacheSwitchBody.message: There are $COUNT$ images in the current location. Move them to the new location?

cacheMoveFail.message: The images could not be moved. Please check the permission for the destination.

cacheCleanupNeeded.message: Some images of deleted posts have not been deleted yet. Check the permission for the destination, then press "Clean up now".

cacheRules.message: Saved images stay on this PC and are never sent anywhere. If you remove the extension, the cache inside the browser is deleted too (a folder you chose is not). Keep images you really want in "a folder I choose". For backing up your saved data itself, use the JSON export (it contains image URLs only, not the images).

fullTextSwitch.message: Fetch the full text of long posts

fullTextSwitchDesc.message: When you save a post that X has collapsed behind “Show more”, PostShelf opens that post’s page in a background tab, reads the full text and closes the tab. It waits 4–8 seconds between posts and never touches the tab you are viewing. X’s terms may treat this as automated access (this is not legal advice). When off, only the collapsed text is saved.

fullTextConfirm.message: This fetches the full text of $COUNT$ posts. Each takes 4–8 seconds, and X post pages are opened and closed in a background tab. X’s terms may treat this as automated access. Start?

fullTextStopLimit.message: Stopped because X seems to have shown a limit or warning. Wait a while and try again.

fullTextStopFailures.message: Stopped because 3 posts in a row could not be fetched.

updateGuide.message: To update: first save your data with "Export", then overwrite the same folder with the new version and press "Reload" for the extension. Do not remove the extension (your saved data would be deleted too).

installGuideLink.message: Steps for updating and manual installation

githubLinkAria.message: View on GitHub (opens in a new tab)

errorStorage.message: Saving or loading failed. Please try again. If it keeps happening, save your data with "Export" in Settings, then reload the extension.

acSubRunningDate.message: Loading at $SPEED$ speed. Now at posts from around $DATE$

acReasonHidden.message: Stopped automatically because you switched to another tab

acReasonCap.message: Stopped because it reached the limit of $COUNT$ posts

acReasonTime.message: Stopped because it reached the 2-hour limit for one import

acReasonReload.message: Stopped because the page was reloaded

acReasonLimit.message: X may have shown a limit

acReasonPage.message: Stopped because you left the bookmarks page

acReasonRefusedAccount.message: Cannot start: the account chosen in the manager is different from the account on x.com

acReasonRefusedUnknown.message: Cannot start: the account on x.com could not be determined

acStartMissed.message: The import did not start on x.com. Open your bookmarks list (/i/history) on x.com, then start again.

acSubStopped.message: Everything up to here has already been imported

acNoteRunning.message: Keep this tab open. Switching to another tab pauses the import automatically.

acNotePaused.message: Resuming continues from where it stopped. Posts already imported are skipped, and new ones are placed to match the order of your X bookmarks.

acNoteReload.message: Resuming reads the list again from the top. Posts already imported are skipped.

acNoteDone.message: Organized in the same order as on X. You can sort them into folders from "Unsorted".

acLimitAlert.message: Stopped because X showed an error or a limit. Wait at least 15 minutes before resuming. Trying again right away may make the limit last longer.

acResumeAt.message: Will resume at $TIME$ (keep this tab open)

acBtnAutoTitle.message: Scrolls the bookmarks tab automatically and imports from it. The limit per run can be changed in the settings

acManualTitle.message: Import only what is visible now

acOfferBody.message: You are using PostShelf for the first time with $ACCOUNT$. It opens "History" → "Bookmarks" on x.com and imports while scrolling the page automatically.

acOfferNever.message: Do not show for this account

acDlgIntro.message: Account: $ACCOUNT$. The bookmarks tab on x.com is scrolled automatically and read.

acRisk.message: Automatic scrolling may be treated as "automated access", which X's terms prohibit. If your account is restricted or anything similar happens, PostShelf's author cannot take responsibility. Import only on your own judgment and only for your own account.

acConsent.message: I understand the above and will run this on my own judgment

acSettingsSwitchDesc.message: When off, the import prompt and the start buttons are hidden. Even when on, nothing starts by itself.

acSettingsNote.message: Automatic scrolling may be treated as "automated access" under X's terms. Please read the confirmation screen before you start.

acNoAccount.message: Cannot start because the account could not be determined. Open x.com, sign in, and try again.

errDuplicateFolder.message: A folder with this name already exists
